run_cli_mcp_server: run an MCP server that wraps a CLI command by passing the command name as an argument
discover_cli_commands: discover all available CLI commands and their parameters by parsing the help output of a CLI tool
register_cli_tool: register a CLI command as an MCP tool with proper parameter handling and type information
parse_command_help: parse the help output of a CLI command to extract positional and optional parameters with descriptions
get_commands_resource: get a JSON list of all available CLI commands and their parameters via the MCP resource endpoint
